entries.text: Place Water Bottles or Potions below to brew.
entries.raw: §7Place Water Bottles or Potions below to brew.
entries.zh: 将水瓶或药水放在下方进行酿造。

entries.text: He might keep the birds away, but he'll certainly look good. This cosmetic scarecrow is a great addition to any farm.
entries.raw: §7He might keep the birds away, but he'll certainly look good. This cosmetic scarecrow is a great addition to any farm.
entries.zh: 驱鸟的本事不好说，但它肯定够好看。这只装饰用稻草人，放在哪片农场都合适。

entries.text: This weapon rack lets you show off %s weapons (swords, pickaxes, or axes).
entries.raw: §7This weapon rack lets you show off %s weapons (swords, pickaxes, or axes).
entries.zh: 此武器架可展示 %s 把武器 (剑、镐或斧)。

entries.text: This cosmetic flower pot looks great in a garden.
entries.raw: §7This cosmetic flower pot looks great in a garden.
entries.zh: 这只装饰花盆摆在花园里十分好看。

entries.text: This cosmetic fireplace looks great in any build.
entries.raw: §7This cosmetic fireplace looks great in any build.
entries.zh: 这座装饰壁炉能为任何建筑增色。

entries.text: This extra large chest looks great in any build.
entries.raw: §7This extra large chest looks great in any build.
entries.zh: 这个特大号箱子能为任何建筑增色。
